tests.name: capture template literal and global variable
capture into a variable with a hyphen
assign to a variable from a captured variable
tests.template: {% capture some %}hello{% endcapture %}{% assign other = some %}{{ some }}-{{ other }}

tests.name: capture increment
tests.template: {% capture x %}{% increment a %}{% endcapture %}[{{ x }}]{% increment a %}

tests.name: capture decrement
tests.template: {% capture x %}{% decrement a %}{% endcapture %}[{{ x }}]{% decrement a %}

tests.name: capture cycle
tests.template: {% capture x %}{% cycle 'a', 'b' %}{% endcapture %}[{{ x }}]{% cycle 'a', 'b' %}

tests.name: capture assign
tests.template: {% capture x %}{% assign y = 2 %}{% endcapture %}[{{ x }}{{ y }}]
